nodes.description: ToshimonMinter public state variable RMU, external minter contract used by claim/redeem.
ToshiCashNonTradable public state variable ToshiCash, points token contract burned/minted by VendingMachine.
mapping(uint256=>uint256) cardCosts storing the point cost of each card id.
addCard(uint256 cardId,uint256 amount) onlyOwner, writes cardCosts.
claim(uint256 card,uint256 quantity) public, burns ToshiCash from msg.sender and mints card via RMU.
redeem(uint256 card,uint256 quantity) public, burns card via RMU and mints ToshiCash to msg.sender.
VendingMachine constructor assigning RMU and ToshiCash addresses.
msg.sender: caller used for balance checks and as token recipient in claim/redeem.
SafeMath.mul(cardCosts[card], quantity) in claim, produces the burn amount.
External call ToshiCash.burn(msg.sender, amount) in claim.
External call RMU.mint(msg.sender, card, quantity, "") in claim, may invoke receiver callback.
SafeMath.mul(cardCosts[card], quantity) in redeem, produces the mint amount.
External call RMU.burn(msg.sender, card, quantity) in redeem.
External call ToshiCash.mint(msg.sender, amount) in redeem.
Parameter cardId of addCard.
Parameter amount of addCard.
Parameter card of claim.
Parameter quantity of claim.
Parameter card of redeem.
Parameter quantity of redeem.
Constructor parameter _RMUAddress.
Constructor parameter _ToshiCashAddress.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in claim for ToshiCash.balanceOf check and as burn/mint recipient.
msg.sender is read in redeem for RMU.balanceOf check and as burn/mint recipient.
msg.sender is the recipient of RMU.mint, whose receiver hook can re-enter claim.
addCard writes cardCosts[cardId] = amount.
claim reads cardCosts[card] for the cost requirement.
redeem reads cardCosts[card] for the payout amount.
claim uses the RMU contract reference to mint cards.
claim uses the ToshiCash contract reference to burn points.
redeem uses the RMU contract reference to burn cards.
redeem uses the ToshiCash contract reference to mint points.
addCard stores amount under mapping key cardId.
addCard writes the amount parameter into cardCosts.
Constructor assigns _RMUAddress to RMU.
Constructor assigns _ToshiCashAddress to ToshiCash.
Constructor writes state variable RMU.
Constructor writes state variable ToshiCash.
claim uses card parameter to index cardCosts and as mint id.
claim uses quantity parameter in the cost multiplication and mint amount.
quantity is an operand of SafeMath.mul in claim.
card indexes cardCosts which is an operand of SafeMath.mul in claim.
claim executes the SafeMath.mul cost computation before burning.
The multiplication result is passed as the amount to ToshiCash.burn in claim.
claim performs the external ToshiCash.burn call.
claim performs the external RMU.mint call after the burn, before completion.
RMU.mint notifies the receiver (msg.sender) which can re-enter claim before state settles.
ToshiCash.burn external call is followed by RMU.mint external call in claim, ordering exposes reentrancy.
redeem uses card parameter to index cardCosts and to burn the card id.
redeem uses quantity parameter for card burn and payout computation.
quantity is an operand of SafeMath.mul in redeem.
card indexes cardCosts which is an operand of SafeMath.mul in redeem.
redeem executes the SafeMath.mul payout computation.
The multiplication result is passed as the amount to ToshiCash.mint in redeem.
quantity is passed as the amount to RMU.burn in redeem.
redeem performs the external RMU.burn call.
redeem performs the external ToshiCash.mint call after burning cards.
RMU state variable provides the target of the mint call in claim.
RMU state variable provides the target of the burn call in redeem.
ToshiCash state variable provides the target of the burn call in claim.
ToshiCash state variable provides the target of the mint call in redeem.
addCard writes into the cardCosts mapping.
addCard is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier (self-guard reference).
